write_only_optimized_field.interpretation: Source writes dst_epoch but never reads it; no independent persistent RTL register exists.

tags.caveat: sel0_sr itself has no reset branch; structural evidence alone does not prove all post-reset read timing or functional session behavior.
tags.logical_default: 64-bit written bitmap clears to zero on reset; q0 selects zero ROM for unwritten addresses

metadata_reset.tags_interpretation: All 64 tag bytes are logically zero after written bitmap reset and a valid CE read updates the select. Physical tag RAM and its output/select pipeline need not be cleared to implement metadata invalidation. Warm-reset command behavior and read timing require actual RTL simulation.

control_r.purpose: nine 64-bit pointer base registers; exact register map must be bound before RTL harness
